Aug hunt orders and silhouettes

While Augs are active, lower-level and mercenary gun buyers may place high-bounty Aug hunt orders, and Aug silhouettes appear in the Underground Shooting League. When off, neither appears; existing orders finish as usual.
Guns in a showcased cabinet count as shown
Placing a Gun Cabinet in the display case counts the guns inside as directly on display, so they attract gun buyers and can be spotted during inspections. When off, only the cabinet itself counts.
Retired Gunsmith clearance visits

The Retired Gunsmith occasionally visits to clear out Gun Cabinets, Gunsmith Storage Bays, and 3D Printing Filament; the more of this gear you already have, the longer between visits. When off, no new visits are scheduled, though scheduled ones still arrive.
Ammo box art by caliber
Sealed ammo boxes display different packaging art based on the caliber inside. When off, all boxes use vanilla art.
New Gunsmith Storage Bay art
Gives the Gunsmith Storage Bay this mod's new art. Reverts to vanilla art when off.
War-damaged guns after a clash
For a few days after a street clash, sellers drawn by firearm neon signs bring war-damaged guns along. When off, they stop appearing; existing war-damaged guns keep their history.
Thieves sell paint crates and sticker packs
Thieves have a chance to sell Paint Crates and Sticker Packs, more often with higher Black Market Reputation. When off, they carry neither.
Spray cans in locked crates
When a firearm neon sign is in your display case, vanilla locked crates have a chance to drop an extra spray can. When off, none drop.
Security's post-clash ammo
After Security wins a street clash, a Requisition Officer visits within a week to sell surplus post-clash ammo at a discount. When off, no new visits trigger; scheduled ones still arrive.
Range crowd visits the shop
Traffic at the range boosts lower-level and mercenary gun buyer visits the next day, and customers may mention the range. Disables this bonus when off.
League in the paper
After Saturday's Underground Shooting League, the next day's newspaper prints the top three. When off, results aren't printed.
Print quality affects gun price
Guns built from self-printed frames have their sale price scaled by print quality. When off, newly assembled guns aren't affected; stats and existing guns stay unchanged.
Dr. Jackson sells the Kotton Nitration Module
Dr. Jackson occasionally sells the Kotton Nitration Hydroponic Module, which makes growing kotton yield loose gunpowder directly. When off, he stops selling it; existing modules still work.
Show the barcode in gun tooltips
Displays the gun's barcode in its tooltip. Hidden when off, without affecting serial tracking.
Sold guns come back around

Guns you sell are tracked, and mercenary gun sellers later have a chance to bring them back to your counter with their paint and history intact. When off, sold guns stop returning; existing records stay.
Famous and war-damaged guns draw buyers

Displaying famous or war-damaged guns in the showcase attracts upper-level and lower-level gun buyers respectively; having a famous gun in the shop adds a famous gun bonus to high-end upper-level orders and may draw collectors offering high prices for a gun by name. When off, none of this triggers; existing orders and gun history stay unchanged.
Famous collector calls
Famous gun collectors usually phone ahead to book a visit for the next day. When off, they walk straight in without calling; visits already booked still happen.
Seal full ammo boxes automatically
Ammo boxes automatically seal once all eight slots are full. When off, seal them manually.
List ammo box contents in its tooltip
Lists the item count by caliber in the ammo box tooltip. Hidden when off.
Show the loaded chip in the printer title
Shows the loaded chip and required materials in the 3D printer's title and tooltip. When off, only the printer's name is shown.
Gunsmith Storage Bay takes workshop goods

Allows the Gunsmith Storage Bay to also store gun cabinets, frames, chips, ammo, melee weapons, metal and electronic materials, and this mod's items. Reverts to vanilla limits when off; items already inside can still be removed.
Vanilla vendors stock ammo and materials

Adds ammo boxes, .45 AFP rounds, 12-gauge shells (requires Permit III), and the Box Dispenser to vanilla vendors, and has Revolution Quartermasters and Raiders bring companions selling arms materials. When off, these extras stop appearing while standard stock stays unchanged.
Sellers stock extra gun mods
Gives gun sellers and vendors a chance to carry this mod's new gun mods (most require Deep content). When off, they aren't sold.
Odin brings the manual
Odin delivers the manual the first time you meet him; if you've already met or he's been arrested, it's still delivered to the shop. Disabled when off.
